title: Chapter 439 Fighting The Supreme Again
content:
Chapter 439 Fighting The Supreme Again

Hearing this sound, everyone in the audience immediately looked at the sound.

I saw three figures, two men and one woman, walking slowly towards here.

When they saw the person behind the young man and woman, everyone exclaimed, "Don't worry about the Human Emperor Palace!"

That is the right-hand man of the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace.

It seems that it has reached the final stage.

Even the left and right arm of the Human Emperor Palace came here, which means that the powerful people who truly stand at the peak of the Chaos Realm will soon arrive.

Everyone present couldn't help but look at the combat power list.

Now, it is less than two days before the end of the combat power list.

"Everyone, don't be fine."

Mo Chou came to the square and waved his hands politely at everyone, with a bright smile.

At this time, the Spirit of the Holy Spirit clan was staring at the two people beside Mo Chou.

The two most famous geniuses in the Human Emperor Palace - Gong Ting and Xu Xingcai.

It is said that the realm of these two people has already reached the Supreme Realm.

For a moment, a strong sense of fighting suddenly emerged from his spiritual and bright eyes.

Feeling Ling's hot gaze, Gong Ting first looked up and faced Ling's four eyes.

"You are the Spirit of the Holy Spirit?"

Gong Ting asked in a low voice.

"It's me." Ling Qie nodded and grinned, "I've heard that the Human Emperor Palace is powerful, but I don't know how powerful the genius in the Human Emperor Palace is?"

Hearing this, Gong Ting snorted and said, "You will know right away."

Then, Gong Ting turned his head to look at Xu Xingcai, and a sunny smile suddenly appeared on his face, and said in a gentle tone: "Xingcai, are you first or me?"

Xu Xingcai's face was calm and he said casually, "You can do it first."

Upon hearing this, Gong Ting nodded and said, "Okay, then I'll wait for you on the top of the Tianjiao List."

Afterwards, Gong Ting thought about it and was about to enter the list of geniuses.

But at this time, Xu Xingcai suddenly said behind her, "Ming Ting."

Gong Ting turned his head to look at Xu Xingcai.

Xu Xingcai whispered: "Be careful, he is not simple."

However, Gong Ting only heard the caution and then immersed in joy.

"Damn it, another young supreme."

"The Supreme Realm is amazing."

On the side of the Heavenly Demon Clan, Xuan Si looked at Gong Ting who had entered the challenge of the Tianjiao List and muttered in a low voice.

Qinghai's eyes were slightly closed, and obviously he didn't plan to make it to the list now.

He naturally chose to stagger the Human Emperor Palace.

Bai Xu sighed slightly, sat cross-legged, and began to stabilize his state.

If he can break through to the Supreme Realm, he will still be very confident to win the top spot, but unfortunately he debuted a little late.

Of course, if the Supreme Taoist fetus was really absorbed by him, he might have been more confident.

But he couldn't.

"I don't know, how is Senior Hao now."

"Oh? By the way, if Senior Hao recovers, can he challenge the combat power list?"

Thinking of this possibility, Bai Xu's expression suddenly lit up.

With Senior Hao's strength, if he can recover, he will definitely be able to surpass the heroes.

"Brother, what are you talking about?"

Seeing Bai Xu talking to himself, Bai Ling asked curiously with his big eyes.

Upon hearing this, Bai Xu remembered that he had not told them about Senior Hao's affairs, and then he sent a message to Bai Ling and the other two about Senior Hao's affairs.

Upon hearing this news, Bai Ling and the other two were shocked.

Qilin and Sheng are the ancestors of their Heavenly Demon Clan.

This is really a great era, even the ancestors of their Heavenly Demon Clan have popped up.

"Bai Xu, when will the ancestor be able to recover?"

Xuan Si looked excited and asked anxiously.

"have no idea."

Bai Xu shook his head slightly, "Senior said that he will come to find me after he recovers."

"That's how it is." Xuan Si smacked his lips and stopped asking.

But this is undoubtedly great news for the Tiande Clan and the entire Chaos Realm.

And at this moment, Xuan Si suddenly exclaimed again: "Damn, look, that guy has actually reached the top ten!"

"Um?!"

Bai Xu and others quickly looked at it and immediately found that Gong Ting's name had reached the top few, and they had made rapid progress.

"Damn it, what a monster!"

Under the list of geniuses, Mo Chou looked at it for a moment and then prepared to leave.

How could he simply escort Gong Ting and Xu Xingcai to the list?

He himself wants to make the rankings.

After all, the rewards for being on the list are generous, so why not do it?

Watching Mo Chou leave the Tianjiao List and head towards the combat power list.

Xu Xingcai stood there, his eyes also looking at the Tianjiao List.

At this time, Gong Ting had already fought with Zhang Changfan.

Seeing this, Xu Xingcai stood up almost at the same time as Bai Xu.

The next moment, both of them disappeared from the spot.

After being on the list, most people will choose to stay in the special space specially provided by the list to practice.

And after someone challenges him, it will be automatically transmitted to the list.

Buzz —

The space trembled, and Bai Xu slowly opened his eyes.

And opposite him, a cold-faced boy was staring at him.

Human Emperor Palace, Palace Ting.

Bai Xu's expression was tense and he did not dare to be careless at all.

"You are the white tiger of the Heavenly Demon Clan?"

Bai Xu nodded slightly.

But Gong Ting shook his head and said, "It's a pity that if you reach the supreme realm, it would be of some significance."

Upon hearing this, Bai Xu said disdainfully: If I were in the Supreme Realm, you would not be enough to see it.

......

A moment later, Bai Xu's figure reappeared in the square.

"Huh? So fast, Bai Xu, what's going on? Is that Gong Ting so strong?"

Seeing Bai Xu back in a short time, Xuan Si asked with some confusion.

At this time, Bai Xu's heart was a little complicated.

After a while of silence, he said, "Ming Ting had various sacrificial moves as soon as he came up. I really can't resist it."

"However, if you want to talk about who is stronger and who is weaker, I am more optimistic about Ling Qie."

"Oh? How do you say this?"

Xuan Si is even more curious.

In contrast, Gong Ting defeated Bai Xu faster, how could he be spiritual and strong?

Bai Xu looked up and looked at the names of Gong Ting and Ling Qi at the top of the Tianjiao List, saying, "Ling Qi always gives me a feeling that I have not used all my strength, but Gong Ting did not."

Upon hearing this, Xuan Si said in surprise: "You mean, when Ling Qi fights you, you may have kept your hand?"

Bai Xu sighed, "It's not possible, it's certain."

Bai Ling looked at his brother with a heartache look in his eyes.

Qinghai always closed his eyes slightly, as if he didn't care about anything.

"Xuan Si, when will you get on?"

"I, I'll get there when Gong Ting and Lingqi decide the winner."

In this way, an hour passed and finally came out.

Top of the list - Lingqi.

Gong Ting lost.

The scene suddenly became an uproar.

Gong Ting, the genius in the Human Emperor Palace, was defeated by the genius of the Holy Spirit Clan. How is this possible?

Could it be that this generation of human race is not as good as the Holy Spirit race?

The human strong man at the scene looked a little unnatural.

The powerful people of the Holy Spirit Clan didn't even dare to laugh, which made them feel a little uncomfortable.
